svg.text: Ramp: outbound GTM system, end to end
svg.textArea: Drawn from context/docs/gtm-system.md (design v1, 2026-11-14). US Mid-Market, segments S1 software, S2 construction, S3 healthcare. Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right.
svg.text: 2 Route, find the people, write the message

rect.data-content:
1C Buying signals
• U1 Finance-ops hiring
• U2 New finance leader
• U3 Headcount up 20%+
• U4 New country or state
• U5 Funding (S1 only)

1D Find companies
Resolve domain, one row per company
Suppress: customer, open opp or recent loss

1F Enrich
Headcount, industry, ownership, ERP, incumbent tool, funding
Exclude with reason. REVIEW goes to a manual queue

1I Tier 1 or Tier 2
• Tier 1: U2, U3 or U4, adds a rep task
• Tier 2: U1 or U5 only

2B S1 Software angle
Card volume, software spend

2C S2 Construction angle
Job-cost coding, crew cards

2D S3 Healthcare angle
One close across locations

2E Find people
• Champion: Controller
• Buyer: CFO or VP Finance

2G Find and verify email
Waterfall, two verifiers, no catch-all

2I Write and QA copy
/campaign-copy from spec and facts.md, then /campaign-qa

3A Send the sequence
3 emails, 2 LinkedIn steps. Stop on any reply

3B Sort replies
Within 1 business day. By hand until Week 4, then n8n
Rest 90 days, re-enter on a new signal

3C HubSpot record
Company, contact, activity, deal with signal attribution

3D Weekly review
Rates by signal, segment and persona. Write back to icp.md, personas.md, signal-matrix.md
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS
